general_rules.name: signature_formal
general_rules.description: Use full signature block for external and formal contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to external clients, suppliers, or formal business contacts
general_rules.action: Add full signature: Sophie Martin\nChef de projet - Division Digitale\nTechCorp | +33 6 12 34 56 78

general_rules.name: signature_casual
general_rules.description: Use first name only for casual internal contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to direct team members (Lucas, Camille) with casual tone

general_rules.name: tutoiement_equipe
general_rules.description: Use tu form with direct team members
general_rules.trigger: Email to Lucas or Camille (casual contacts)
general_rules.action: Use tu form, casual greetings (Salut), first name only closing

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_clients
general_rules.description: Use vous form with external clients and formal contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to external clients, suppliers, or formal business partners
general_rules.action: Use vous form, formal greetings (Bonjour Madame/Monsieur)

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_management
general_rules.description: Use vous form with management and semi-formal internal contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to CEO, finance, and senior internal contacts like Pierre, Nicolas
general_rules.action: Use vous form with semi-formal tone

general_rules.name: language_switch
general_rules.description: Switch to English for international partners
general_rules.trigger: Email to contacts with non-French domains (.com, .co.kr, .de)

general_rules.name: structured_updates
general_rules.description: Use numbered lists and bullet points for status reports
general_rules.trigger: Status updates, sprint planning, action items, meeting recaps
general_rules.action: Structure content with numbered lists, bullet points, clear sections

general_rules.name: action_items_section
general_rules.description: End client emails with Actions à suivre section
general_rules.trigger: Client meeting recaps and project status emails
general_rules.action: Add 'Actions à suivre :' section at end with clear next steps

general_rules.name: cc_relevant_people
general_rules.description: CC technical leads and stakeholders on technical discussions
general_rules.trigger: Technical questions, partnership discussions, client technical topics
general_rules.action: CC Pierre Durand for technical matters, relevant team members for their expertise

general_rules.name: concise_acknowledgments
general_rules.trigger: Simple confirmations, ticket closures, absence acknowledgments
general_rules.action: Write 1-2 sentence responses without full signature

general_rules.name: detailed_technical_proposals
general_rules.description: Provide structured technical proposals with numbered options
general_rules.trigger: Technical problem-solving, architecture decisions, implementation choices
general_rules.action: Present numbered options with clear pros/cons, ask for input

general_rules.name: professional_reminders
general_rules.description: Keep team reminders friendly but structured
general_rules.trigger: Team-wide announcements, meeting reminders, process changes
general_rules.action: Use clear subject lines, bullet points, friendly tone while maintaining authority

auto_reply_patterns: Absence/congé acknowledgment: Short casual response (Pas de souci, profite bien! Sophie)
VPN/IT issue resolution: Brief confirmation ticket can be closed
Quick agreement on technical point: Single sentence confirmation (OK pour X, on le met dans sprint Y. Sophie)
Meeting time confirmation: Single sentence confirmation with name
